title: The comprehensive Ziyarat of the Imams (a)
data:
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَاۤ اَوْلِيَآءَ اللّٰهِ وَ اَحِبَّآءَهٗ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKUM YAA AWLIYAAA'ALLAAHI WA AHIBBAAA'AH
Peace be upon you, O saints of Allah and His beloved ones!
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا صَفْوَةَ اللّٰهِ وَ خِيَرَتَهٗ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKUM YAA SAFWATALLAAHI WA KHIYARATAH
Peace be upon you, O chosen ones of Allah and His elite!
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا حُجَجَ اللّٰهِ عَلٰى خَلْقِهٖ وَ اَعْلَامَ دِيْنِهٖ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKUM YAA HUJAJALLAAHI A'LAA KHALQIHEE WA A'LAAMA DEENIH
Peace be upon you, O proofs of Allah over His creation and guideposts of His religion!
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا مَعَادِنَ حِكْمَةِ اللّٰهِ وَ حَفَظَةَ سِرِّ اللّٰهِ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKUM YAA MA'AADINA HIKMATILLAAHI WA HAFADhATA SIRRILLAAH
Peace be upon you, O sources of Allah's wisdom and keepers of Allah's secret!
merits: The Comprehensive Ziyarah of the Holy Imams (a.s.) (al-Ziyarah al-Jami'ah) can be recited when visiting any of the Holy Imams in all months and days, as recorded by Sayyid Ibn Tawus in Misbah al-Za'ir.
